abstract: Abstract Growing recognition of biodiversity's role in supporting agricultural productivity has prompted economists and other scholars to quantify the “productive value” of crop biodiversity using observational data from real‐world conditions. We present the first meta‐analysis of that literature, drawing on 158 estimates from 52 observational studies published between 1998 and 2025. Overall, crop biodiversity exhibits a positive and statistically significant effect on agricultural productivity, with an average elasticity of 0.75—meaning a 1% increase in crop biodiversity (proxied by diversity indexes) raises agricultural outcomes by 0.75%. Yet, this average masks considerable heterogeneity across and within studies (standard deviation of 1.23). Complementary meta‐regression analyses attribute much of this heterogeneity to differences in research settings: biodiversity indexes based on species richness yield larger effects than evenness‐based ones, profit‐related outcomes show stronger associations with biodiversity than production‐related ones, and instrumental variable estimates exceed those from other methods. We further detect signs of selective reporting in our sample, with published estimates clustering just above conventional significance thresholds. Adjusting for this bias reduces average effects substantially, though the corrected evidence still points toward a positive—though more modest—productive value of crop biodiversity.
abstract_zh: 摘要 生物多样性在支撑农业生产率中的作用日益受到认可，促使经济学家及其他学者利用现实世界条件下的观测数据，量化作物生物多样性的“生产价值”。我们对该领域文献进行了首次元分析，基于1998年至2025年间发表的52项观测研究中的158个估计值。总体而言，作物生物多样性对农业生产率表现出正向且统计显著的影响，平均弹性为0.75——这意味着作物生物多样性（以多样性指数为代理）每增加1%，农业产出将提高0.75%。然而，这一平均值掩盖了研究内部及研究间显著的异质性（标准差为1.23）。补充的元回归分析将这种异质性大部分归因于研究设置的差异：基于物种丰富度的生物多样性指数所产生的效应大于基于均匀度的指数；与利润相关的产出结果显示出比生产相关结果更强的生物多样性关联；工具变量估计值则超过其他方法所得结果。我们进一步检测到样本中存在选择性报告的迹象，已发表估计值聚集在常规显著性阈值略上方。对此偏差进行调整后，平均效应大幅降低，尽管修正后的证据仍指向正向——但更为温和——的作物生物多样性生产价值。
title: A meta‐analysis on the productive value of crop biodiversity
title_zh: 作物生物多样性生产价值的元分析
